description: This file defines pin control configurations and structures for the NXP i.MX MIMX8ML8 M7 SoC within the Zephyr RTOS, including macros for pin configuration initialization and data structures for pin multiplexing.

classes.name: pinctrl_soc_pinmux
classes.description: Structure representing pin multiplexing configuration for the SoC.

classes.name: pinctrl_soc_pin
classes.description: Structure representing a pin with its multiplexing and control flags.

methods.name: MCUX_IMX_PINMUX
methods.description: Macro to initialize pinmux structure from device tree node.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_PINMUX
methods.description: Macro to generate pinmux configuration for a specific group and index.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PIN_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize a pin state with pinmux and control flags.

methods.name: Z_PINCTRL_STATE_PINS_INIT
methods.description: Macro to initialize multiple pins for a device tree node.
